about: One row per run mode. Each row generates one ModeDef. 'tier' is how many times the bracket has been cleared (0 in a fresh run); scaling applies per tier on top of the game's own opponent stats.

columns.entry: how the player gets into this mode
columns.slot_rule: how the game's bracket slot (gameNumber 1-8) is chosen
columns.card_rule: which reward cards are offered after a win
columns.best_key: save field updated by this mode, or '-'
columns.banner: title-card text format at match start ({n} match number, {loop}, {bracket} game's bracket name)
columns.verified: how it was seen working, or 'no'

rows.final_win: game's Win screen, plus a 'Keep going' button that enters Loop 2

rows.entry: new INFINITE button on the title screen
rows.slot_rule: ((n-1) mod 8)+1 picks the slot class (teams.json slots); the opponent is random from that class's pool of vanilla and new teams, never one of the last 3
rows.card_rule: perk on 2 of every 3 wins, stats on the 3rd; Limit Break once at the game's limit-break match; stats when fewer than 2 perks remain
rows.final_win: upgrade screen, then the bracket repeats one tier harder
rows.verified: partial: start, slots 1-2, banner, rewards, lose/save, restart seen; random teams, tier 1+ and slot 8 not yet

rows.entry: 'Keep going' button on the Win screen
rows.slot_rule: game default 1-8, wrapping 9 to 1; opponents random from the slot class's pool like Infinite
rows.card_rule: game default; a Limit Break card already owned becomes a perk pick
